title: Jeffrey Donaldson: Case 'on track' with next stage in July  - BBC News
text: The prosecution case against former Democratic Unionist Party (DUP) leader Sir Jeffrey Donaldson on historical sex offence charges is progressing “on track”, a review hearing in Newry has heard.

title: Trains between Eastleigh and Fareham stop as suspected bomb found - BBC News
text: A cordon was put in place and officers from British Transport Police, and Network Rail were alerted to the discovery Passengers faced train disruptions this morning after a suspected wartime bomb was discovered at a housing development near the tracks.

title: Evangelos Marinakis: Nottingham Forest owner 'undermined respect for game' says FA - BBC Sport
text: Nottingham Forest owner Evangelos Marinakis' appeal against a five-game stadium ban was dismissed to "send a clear message" after he "undermined respect for the game of football," says the Football Association (FA).

title: Newham: Residents warned after gas bottle explodes in bin lorry - BBC News
